additional_info.subject: ID0406908-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313875948001] REWE-Outlet 2 was out of order CRM:01251001250
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes Dissauer,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Sunil
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
REWE Inzersdorf_EQ:71141735
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
8qgG8Z
Problem Description
: Outlet 2 was out of order
Troubleshooting
:
As checked in Logs from time around 12:26:00 UTC, Charging session was in progress in DC1 & DC 4.
In DC1 the SOC was almost 100%.When Charging session in DC1 stopped form EV side, QA09-10 i.e the switching matrix between DC1 & DC2
Contactor coil is not operating properly as the command from PLC was to open but the feedback was still close this result in fault due to which DC2 goes out of order.
Also we have analyzed the data for the past 1 month for QA09-10 & we have observed there was very frequent error , the error has occurred around 43 times.
so we need to align with the region for parts ordering & replacement activity.
For future reference, your case number is
0406908
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma

to it.
